title: Persona Alchemy: Designing, Evaluating, and Implementing Psychologically-Grounded LLM Agents for Diverse Stakeholder Representation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the authenticity and psychological consistency of LLM agents designed to represent diverse stakeholder perspectives and ideologies (e.g., progressive, conservative, eco-indigenous) in polarized socio-political discourse without relying on out-group stereotypes.

Measuring how agent personas evolve and respond across multiple interactions when presented with factual information and counter-evidence of varying reliability that directly contradicts their established ideological beliefs.
